default_domain.description: The default domain or host name to analyze if none is specified via DOMAINS.

default_number_of_events.description: The default number of recent USB events to retrieve.

default_output_format.description: The default output format for events, either 'table' or 'list'.

external_only.description: If true, filters for external USB events (devices that were disconnected).

quiet_mode.description: If true, suppresses banner output, info messages, and user interaction.

output_file.description: Path to save the output to disk.

target_url.description: The target URL for downloading or updating the USB ID database.

word_list.description: Word list to be tested (specific context dependent).

parallel_tasks.description: Number of connections in parallel (per host).

extensions.description: Extensions to append to each request (comma-separated).

storage_type.description: The storage type to list contents of, either 'history' or 'violations'.

offline_search.description: If true, performs USB ID search offline.

input_auth_file.description: Path to the input authentication JSON file for violation checks.

output_auth_file.description: Path to the output authentication JSON file for trusted devices.

input_dump_file.description: Path to the input dump JSON file for events open.

domains.description: One or more domains to perform USB forensics on.

date_filters.description: List of dates to filter events by.

vid_filters.description: List of Vendor IDs to filter by.

pid_filters.description: List of Product IDs to filter by.

product_filters.description: List of product names to filter by.

manufacturer_filters.description: List of manufacturer names to filter by.

serial_filters.description: List of serial numbers to filter by.

host_filters.description: List of hostnames to filter by.

port_filters.description: List of ports to filter by.

columns.description: List of columns to display in table format.

auth_attributes.description: List of attributes to include in authentication file generation.

history_files.description: List of external files to load event history from.
